title.en: The grandfather who studied the stars

recall.uz: Buyuk olim va shoh Mirzo Ulugʻbek haqidagi matnni tinglab oʻqiymiz va uning rasadxonasi haqida bilib olamiz.
recall.ru: Слушаем текст о великом учёном и правителе Мирзо Улугбеке и узнаём о его обсерватории.
recall.en: We read about the great scholar and ruler Mirzo Ulugbek and learn about his observatory.

props.title: Mirzo Ulugʻbek
lines: Mirzo Ulugʻbek buyuk olim va adolatli shoh boʻlgan.
Ulugʻbek yulduzlar ilmini — astronomiyani chuqur oʻrgangan.
U yerda osmon, oy va yulduzlarni kuzatgan.
Uning ilmiy ishlari butun dunyoga mashhur boʻlgan.

prompt.ru: Послушай и читай, следя за текстом!
prompt.en: Listen and follow along as you read!

hint.en: What did Ulugbek build in Samarkand?

explanation.uz: Matn olim va shoh Mirzo Ulugʻbek hamda uning rasadxonasi haqida.
explanation.ru: Текст об учёном и правителе Мирзо Улугбеке и его обсерватории.
explanation.en: The text is about the scholar-ruler Mirzo Ulugbek and his observatory.

statement.en: Ulugbek built an observatory in Samarkand.

why.ru: В тексте сказано, что он построил обсерваторию в Самарканде.
why.en: The text says he built a large observatory in Samarkand.

prompt.en: According to the text, what is this statement?

hint.en: Where did Ulugbek watch the stars?

explanation.ru: Верно: Улугбек построил обсерваторию в Самарканде.
explanation.en: True: Ulugbek built an observatory in Samarkand.

statement.en: Ulugbek studied the bottom of the sea.

why.uz: Aksincha, u osmon, oy va yulduzlarni oʻrgangan.
why.ru: Наоборот, он изучал небо, луну и звёзды.
why.en: On the contrary, he studied the sky, moon and stars.

prompt.en: According to the text, what is this statement?

explanation.en: False: he studied the heavenly bodies.

choices.en: A scholar and a just ruler

hint.uz: U ham ilm bilan, ham davlat bilan shugʻullangan.
hint.ru: Он занимался и наукой, и государством.
hint.en: He was involved in both science and the state.

explanation.uz: Mirzo Ulugʻbek — buyuk olim va adolatli shoh boʻlgan.
explanation.ru: Мирзо Улугбек был великим учёным и справедливым правителем.
explanation.en: Mirzo Ulugbek was a great scholar and a just ruler.

openEnd.uz: Sen ham osmonni kuzatganmisan? Nima koʻrgansan?
openEnd.ru: Ты наблюдал за небом? Что видел?
openEnd.en: Have you watched the sky? What did you see?

prompt.ru: Что наблюдал Улугбек в обсерватории? Нажми!
prompt.en: What did Ulugbek observe at the observatory? Tap!

explanation.uz: Ulugʻbek osmon, oy va yulduzlarni kuzatgan; poyabzal va qoshiq — yoʻq.
explanation.ru: Улугбек наблюдал небо, луну и звёзды; обувь и ложка — нет.
explanation.en: Ulugbek observed the sky, moon and stars; a shoe and a spoon — no.

prompt.en: Match each word to its meaning!

explanation.uz: rasadxona = kuzatish binosi; nevara = farzand farzandi; astronomiya = yulduzlar fani.
explanation.ru: rasadxona = обсерватория; nevara = внук; astronomiya = наука о звёздах.
explanation.en: rasadxona = an observatory; nevara = a grandchild; astronomiya = the science of stars.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence with the right word!

prompt.ru: Выбери слово и вставь в пропуск!
prompt.en: Pick a word and fill each gap!

hint.ru: Он построил здание для изучения неба.
hint.en: He built a place to study the sky.

explanation.uz: «Ulugʻbek rasadxona qurib, u yerda yulduzlarni kuzatgan».
explanation.ru: «Улугбек построил обсерваторию и наблюдал там звёзды».
explanation.en: “Ulugbek built an observatory and watched the stars there.”

prompt.en: Build the wise sentence from the words!

explanation.uz: «Ilm — eng katta boylik»: bilim insonni ulugʻ qiladi.
explanation.ru: «Знание — самое большое богатство»: оно возвышает человека.
explanation.en: “Knowledge is the greatest wealth”: it makes a person great.

clue.en: A building for watching the stars

prompt.en: Build the word from the syllables!

explanation.uz: ra-sad-xo-na → rasadxona. Ulugʻbek shunday bino qurgan.
